our_interpretation: Assess the asserted causal change as of 2024-03-11.
Stronger means greater capacity to obtain distribution or viral reach; more nuanced means more adaptive or sophisticated manipulation.
Retain the source's displacement claim about audience interest rather than reducing it to the weaker proposition that some AI content becomes popular.
A fair test distinguishes increased production capacity from increased success in manipulating recommendations.
criteria.support_condition: Comparisons establish that generative AI increased manipulation sophistication and viral reach, and that manipulated recommendation systems displaced audience interest as the principal explanation of the virality being described.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative comparisons show no such AI-caused improvement, or establish that audience interest remains central rather than being displaced by AI-enhanced manipulation.

evidence.explanation: The investigation establishes substantial reach for apparent AI-generated conspiracy videos before publication. It supports the existence of successful AI-assisted content, but cannot distinguish algorithm manipulation from audience interest or show the incremental effect of AI.

OpenAI distinguishes manufactured engagement from genuine audience response in the operations it investigated. These later cases caution against equating AI assistance with viral success, but cannot directly contradict the state asserted on March 11.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated comparative campaign evidence linking AI adoption to more sophisticated manipulation and additional viral reach, together with measurements separating recommendation effects from audience preferences.
